payload.summary: Six corrected ledger sources were reset to unverified and need a fresh owner review, not a re-attestation
payload.detail: REVIEW 2026-09-25 (offline audit of current main; no provider access): PR #2815 (5b1a8cf8f) reset all six to validationStatus unverified; only two records in src/data/source-acquisitions.json are still locally_reviewed, and they are other Chief Psychiatrist sources. The six now sit in the Sources sign-off queue as ordinary candidates. PRIOR DETAIL: IMPLEMENTED 2026-09-16 by commit 2f7072e43: the six publisher-page corrections (RANZCP mood guideline documentStatus outdated; five Chief Psychiatrist guidelines publicationDate 2015-12-01 and version December 2025 revision) are applied. Residual only: all six remain validationStatus locally_reviewed from the owner's 2026-09-06 sign-off, which predates the corrections, so each still needs owner re-attestation rather than another agent edit. CORRECTION to the original claim that wrong publication dates overstated Currency by about ten years: Currency is scored from documentStatus alone in src/lib/sources/catalogue-core.ts; publicationDate contributes only a boolean to traceability. Measured: the five Chief Psychiatrist guidelines score 91 band A both before and after; only the RANZCP documentStatus change moved a score (band A to B, 89 to 74). Verify with npm run check:source-acquisitions.
